scoring_justification: Recompute occupation numbers from binding energies and compare to paper gold; compare binding energies directly to paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold binding energies and occupation numbers inline.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports decorated binding ~0.04 eV, released first ~0.33 eV, second ~0.26 eV, max=2; occupation 0.9 and 1.9 at 25°C/-78°C and 60 atm.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper text (sentences reporting binding energies and occupation numbers).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported numbers; using them as reference targets ensures the checker aligns with the paper's claim. No random data generated.

outputs.description: DFT-calculated H2 binding energies (raw, without zero-point correction) on the benzyl-decorated and benzyl-released Ti(III) complexes, and the maximum number of H2 that can bind to the released complex.

Equilibrium H2 occupation numbers on the benzyl-released Ti(III) complex at 298 K, 60 atm and 195 K, 60 atm, computed from the DFT binding energies reduced by 25% and using the grand partition function.

output_contract.notes: The binding energies are raw DFT values; the occupation numbers are computed after reducing those binding energies by 25% for zero-point energy. The checker will compare both sets of numbers to the paper's reported values with tolerances.

steps.description: Check raw DFT binding energies and max H2 count against paper gold (tolerance ±0.05 eV).
Compute occupation numbers from submitted binding energies (reduced by 25%) and compare to paper gold (0.9 and 1.9) within ±0.2; also check internal consistency with the reported occupation numbers.
